title: On the Complexity of Offline Reinforcement Learning with Q*-Approximation and Partial Coverage
abstract: arXiv:2602.12107v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study offline reinforcement learning under $Q^\star$-approximation and partial coverage, a setting that motivates practical algorithms such as Conservative $Q$-Learning (CQL; Kumar et al., 2020) but has received limited theoretical attention. Our work is inspired by the following open question: "Are $Q^\star$-realizability and Bellman completeness sufficient for sample-efficient offline RL under partial coverage?"   We answer in the negative via an information-theoretic lower bound. To identify additional structure that enables sample-efficient offline RL under partial coverage, we introduce a general decision-estimation framework, inspired by model-free decision-estimation coefficients (DEC) for online RL (Foster et al., 2023b; Liu et al., 2025b). translated_title: 关于具有 Q\* 近似与部分覆盖的离线强化学习的复杂性研究
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在 Q\* 近似与部分覆盖条件下的离线强化学习，这一设定激发了许多实用算法（如保守 Q 学习，CQL；Kumar 等，2020），但其受到的理论关注十分有限。我们的工作受到以下开放问题的启发：“Q\* 可实现性与贝尔曼完整性是否足以支撑部分覆盖下样本高效的离线强化学习？”我们通过信息论下界对该问题给出了否定回答。为了识别能够使部分覆盖下样本高效离线强化学习成为可能的额外结构，我们受在线强化学习中无模型决策估计系数（DEC）（Foster 等，2023b；Liu 等，2025b）的启发，引入了一个通用的决策估计框架。该框架将离线强化学习的复杂度分解为决策复杂度和价值估计误差，从而可以对这两个子问题进行模块化研究。我们的结果不仅统一了已有的……
tldr: 该论文通过信息论下界证明仅凭 Q\* 可实现性与贝尔曼完整性不足以实现部分覆盖下样本高效的离线强化学习，并提出一个通用的决策估计框架，将离线强化学习的复杂度分解为决策复杂度与价值估计误差两部分。
en_tdlr: This paper shows via an information-theoretic lower bound that Q\*-realizability and Bellman completeness alone are insufficient for sample-efficient offline RL under partial coverage, and introduces a general decision-estimation framework that decomposes offline RL complexity into decision complexity and value estimation error.
